episodes.synopsis: Though he's excited to attend Professor Oak's Pokémon camp, Ash oversleeps when the day arrives. Newcomer Goh is just as excited — and on time.
episodes.title: Enter Pikachu!

episodes.synopsis: Professor Oak invites Ash to the opening ceremony for Professor Cerise's new lab in Vermilion City. Goh sets out to catch a legendary Pokémon.
episodes.title: Legend? Go! Friends? Go!

episodes.synopsis: Professor Cerise asks Ash and Goh to investigate the sudden appearance of Ivysaur in Vermilion City, but the two researchers disagree on their methods.
episodes.title: Ivysaur's Mysterious Tower!

episodes.synopsis: Ash and Goh head to the Galar region on assignment. During their stopover, some Pokémon steal Ash's backpack — with Ash and Goh's train tickets inside!
episodes.title: Settling the Scorebunny!

episodes.synopsis: Once they get off the train, Ash and Goh set out on the hunt for Dynamax Pokémon. Meanwhile, a Scorbunny is hot on their trail.
episodes.title: Mind-Boggling Dynamax!

episodes.synopsis: After learning more about the Pokédex functions on their Rotom Phones from Professor Cerise, Ash and Goh head out to catch some local Pokémon.
episodes.title: Working My Way Back to Mew!

episodes.synopsis: Ash and Goh travel to the Hoenn region, where Ash has entered Goh into the Battle Frontier Flute Cup. Their first opponents are Hodge and his Hariyama.
episodes.title: Serving Up the Flute Cup!

episodes.synopsis: The internet is full of reports that legendary Pokémon Ho-Oh has been seen in the Johto region. The researchers head to Ecruteak City to check it out.
episodes.title: The Sinnoh Iceberg Race!

episodes.synopsis: The internet is full of reports that legendary Pokémon Ho-Oh has been seen in the Johto region. The researchers head to Ecruteak City to check it out.
episodes.title: Finding a Legend!

episodes.synopsis: After a ship's captain reports being saved by a Dragonite, Goh and Ash set out in search of the Dragonite island that they believe exists ... somewhere.
episodes.title: A Test in Paradise!

episodes.synopsis: While the laboratory staff deal with a mysterious power outage, Chloe contemplates her future and her relationship with Pokémon.
episodes.title: Best Friend... Worst Nightmare!

episodes.synopsis: Professor Cerise gives Ash and Goh tickets to the World Coronation Series finals in the Galar region, where the strongest trainers battle for glory!
episodes.title: Flash of the Titans!

episodes.synopsis: When a Gigantamax Drednaw interrupts the World Coronation finals in pursuit of Team Rocket, Ash, Goh and their Pokémon spring into action!
episodes.title: The Climb to Be the Very Best!

episodes.synopsis: Ash and Goh travel to the Unova region, where they head to the newly discovered Ruins of the Titan site at Desert Resort to search for Pokémon.
episodes.title: Raid Battle in the Ruins!

episodes.synopsis: After snow in Vermilion City forces Professor Cerise to shut down the lab for system maintenance, Goh heads home for a few days to visit his family.
episodes.title: A Snow Day for Searching!

episodes.synopsis: Gengar's hauntings at the lab resume. Ash and Goh vow to capture the poltergeist Pokémon, and Professor Cerise explains the lab's paranormal history.
episodes.title: A Chilling Curse!

episodes.synopsis: After Darmanitan taunts Scorbunny in a practice battle, Scorbunny is determined to learn the Ember attack, but getting Goh's attention is a challenge.
episodes.title: Kicking It from Here Into Tomorrow!

episodes.synopsis: Ash and Goh head to the Vermilion Gym, where Ash challenges the substitute Gym Leader as his first World Coronation Series opponent.
episodes.title: Destination: Coronation!

episodes.synopsis: Goh and Ash visit a film set, where the star, a Ditto, flees after a fight with the director. They search for her, but she's fallen in with Team Rocket!
episodes.title: A Talent for Imitation!

episodes.synopsis: Pokémon Orienteering day dawns bright and early, with Ash, Goh and Professor Cerise each leading a group of kids on a trek through Vermilion City.
episodes.title: Dreams Are Made of These!

episodes.synopsis: After learning about Pokémon Eggs, Goh wants to find one. Ash's latest World Coronation Series match ends with him feeling like someone is calling him.
episodes.title: Caring for a Mystery!

episodes.synopsis: Ash and Goh head to the Hoenn region to witness the annual migration of Beautifly, but first they have to find them. Goh's Raboot starts acting out.
episodes.title: Goodbye, Friend!

episodes.synopsis: Someone seems to be stealing the food that the researchers leave out for Pokémon in Cerise Park. To catch the culprit, Ash and Goh camp out.
episodes.title: Panic in the Park!

episodes.synopsis: Team Rocket are sent to the Sinnoh region for a vacation, but their break is interrupted by the arrival of Ash and Goh looking for a special Pokémon.
episodes.title: A Little Rocket R & R!

episodes.synopsis: Ash and Goh head to the Kalos region, where Goh wants to catch Kalos Pokémon and Ash sets his sights on a World Coronation Series Battle Festival.
episodes.title: A Festival Reunion!

episodes.synopsis: Goh enters his giant Magikarp in the tenth annual Magikarp High Jump Tournament. Then he and Ash head to Slowpoke Island, hoping to catch a Slowpoke.
episodes.title: Splash, Dash, and Smash for the Crown! / Slowking's Crowning!

episodes.synopsis: Professor Cerise gives Ash and Goh tickets to a World Coronation Series Master Class battle in Galar, with challenger Raihan battling champion Leon.
episodes.title: Toughing It Out!

episodes.synopsis: A Sobble sneaks up on Ash and Goh while they're eating at the Wyndon Pokémon Center. To catch it, they have to follow a trail of crying people.
episodes.title: Sobbing Sobble!

episodes.synopsis: Yamper brings home an injured Pidove, so Professor Cerise and his family decide to nurse it back to health. Chloe has her hands full keeping the peace!
episodes.title: There's a New Kid in Town!

episodes.synopsis: Ash and Riolu are on a roll after the latest World Coronation Series battle, and Pikachu is jealous! When Ash's mom visits, Pikachu follows her home.
episodes.title: Betrayed, Bothered, and Beleaguered!

episodes.synopsis: Chloe asks Ash and Goh to step in at her younger brother Parker's school: His friend Nami is upset that other kids say her Feebas isn't cute.
episodes.title: The Cuteness Quotient!

episodes.synopsis: Goh joins his parents for a family vacation in the Johto region. Walking through the woods, he recalls meeting another trainer there three years ago.
episodes.title: Time After Time!

episodes.synopsis: The local Pokémon Center is hosting a Pokémon trading event. When Ash and Goh head over to check it out, they meet a trainer who's a Bug-type enthusiast.
episodes.title: Trade, Borrow, and Steal!

episodes.synopsis: Ash travels to Saffron City to battle his next opponent, but when he learns that the Karate Master has been defeated, he challenges the victor instead.
episodes.title: Solitary and Menacing!

episodes.synopsis: Goh decides to catch a Pikachu, and Professor Cerise informs him about a mass outbreak of Pikachu in the mountains. But Team Rocket is on the hunt too!
episodes.title: Gotta Catch a What?!

episodes.synopsis: After Ash battles new opponents in the World Coronation Series, the Cerise Laboratory researchers head to the Hoenn region to investigate a sandstorm.
episodes.title: Making Battles in the Sand!

episodes.synopsis: Ash and Goh head to the Alola region and reunite with Professor Kukui, Professor Burnet and Ash's human and Pokémon friends at the Pokémon School.
episodes.title: That New Old Gang of Mine!

episodes.synopsis: With Chloe in tow, Ash and Goh visit the Pewter Museum of Science. Goh heads to a public dig site to find a Fossil Pokémon, but Team Rocket is there!
episodes.title: Restore and Renew!

episodes.synopsis: Goh and Ash travel to the Cianwood Gym in the Johto region so Ash can take on Bea in a World Coronation Series rematch.
episodes.title: Octo-Gridlock at the Gym!

episodes.synopsis: When a hot day in Vermilion City turns thunderous, Ash, Goh and Professor Cerise suspect that the Legendary bird Pokémon Zapdos is somewhere nearby.
episodes.title: A Crackling Raid Battle!

episodes.synopsis: While Meowth battles a cold, Jessie and James review a video of Ash's Pikachu. On a forest walk, Ash and Goh try to help a wild Marshtomp.
episodes.title: Pikachu Translation Check! / Up to Your Neck!

episodes.synopsis: Ash and Goh set out for the Galar region to investigate the Dynamax phenomenon. During a train delay, they meet strange Pokémon in a mysterious forest.
episodes.title: Sword and Shield, Slumbering Weald!

episodes.synopsis: While Goh and Sonia investigate the Darkest Day in Turffield, Team Rocket infiltrates the Galar Energy Plant, with Ash and Leon heading there too.
episodes.title: Sword and Shield: The Darkest Day!

episodes.synopsis: Ash heads to Stow-on-Side to meet Sonia and Goh, who conclude that the Darkest Day is a Pokémon. At the Energy Plant, Leon encounters it directly.
episodes.title: Sword and Shield: From Here to Eternatus!

episodes.synopsis: At the stadium, Leon and Team Rocket are no match for Eternatus. Ash takes on Chairman Rose while Goh battles Oleana to break through and end the chaos.
episodes.title: Sword and Shield... The Legends Awaken!

episodes.synopsis: When Psychic energy is detected on Cero Island, Ash and Goh head out in hopes of finding Mew. When they get there, they meet an old foe: Mewtwo!
episodes.title: Getting More Than You Battled For!

episodes.synopsis: The Vermilion City Pokémon Eating Contest is on, and Ash, Goh and their Pokémon are competing for a trip to Unova. Team Rocket wants to win too.
episodes.title: Crowning the Chow Crusher!

episodes.synopsis: Setting out on Goh's prize trip, Ash and Goh arrive in Castelia City. Unbeknownst to them, Team Rocket is lying in wait to kidnap Pikachu!
episodes.title: A Close Call... Practically!

episodes.synopsis: A mysterious Eevee runs away from the Eevee Evolution Laboratory and meets Chloe. Meanwhile, Team Rocket makes a plan to steal some students' Pokémon.
episodes.title: To Train, or Not to Train!

episodes.synopsis: Ash, Goh and Chloe head to the Galar region to investigate some of its unusual fossils. The on-site researchers want to reconstruct the ancient Pokémon.
episodes.title: A Pinch of This, A Pinch of That!

episodes.synopsis: Investigating an outbreak of Geodude in Rock Tunnel, Ash and Goh meet a trainer who accepts Ash's challenge to a World Coronation battle with Gurdurr!
episodes.title: Trials of a Budding Master!

episodes.synopsis: When Professor Cerise's former student asks for help with some Diglett and Dugtrio wreaking havoc on his farm, Goh, Ash and Chloe go check it out.
episodes.title: How Are Ya Gonna Keep 'Em Off of the Farm?

episodes.synopsis: Hearing rumors that the legendary Suicune has been spotted at a lake, Ash and Goh travel to the Johto region, where they find a human polluting plot.
episodes.title: Healing the Healer!

episodes.synopsis: Goh and Ash visit the set of a popular spy movie. When the film's Inteleon star cinematically foils a Team Rocket attack, Goh's Sobble is inspired.
episodes.title: Sobble Spies a Stealthy Strategy!

episodes.synopsis: Chloe, Ash and Goh head to Glimwood Tangle to learn more about Galarian Ponyta and Rapidash. Separated in the forest, they have storybook adventures.
episodes.title: The Tale of You and Glimwood Tangle!

episodes.synopsis: After hearing about Wikstrom of the Kalos Elite Four, Ash and Goh travel to his castle to take his test alongside their Farfetch'd and Scyther.
episodes.title: Searching for Chivalry!

episodes.synopsis: While Ash and Goh take advantage of a cold snap to search for Ice Pokémon, Chloe enjoys some girls' time with lab assistant Chrysa at her apartment.
episodes.title: Memories of a Warming Kindness

episodes.synopsis: When Team Rocket's Pelipper dispenses too many Gulpin from the Prize Master, trouble rolls through Vermilion City. Then, the race is on with Chewtle!
episodes.title: A Rollicking Roll…Eyes on the Goal!

episodes.synopsis: Goh finds a Grookey in the lab and tries to capture it, only to learn it belongs to someone else. To locate its owner, he and Ash set out on a search.
episodes.title: When a House Is Not a Home!

episodes.synopsis: Ash runs into Rinto, who's also in the World Coronation Series, at the Pokémon Center. He and Farfetch'd challenge Rinto and Gallade to a rematch!
episodes.title: Beyond Chivalry…Aiming to Be a Leek Master!

episodes.synopsis: Goh and Ash offer to help handyperson Multa after her partner is injured. Out on the job, they cross paths with Team Rocket and their latest plot.
episodes.title: Searching for Service with a Smile!

episodes.synopsis: Goh's Sobble evolves into a Drizzile. But for some reason, it withdraws to a cave in Cerise Park, much to Goh's consternation.
episodes.title: Not Too Close for Comfort!

episodes.synopsis: Chloe, Ash and Goh head to Hoenn to meet race champion trainer Kiley and his Vaporeon. At his suggestion, they enter the Kids Marine Athletic Race.
episodes.title: On Land, in the Sea, and to the Future!

episodes.synopsis: Goh and Ash travel to Lavaridge Town to help their old friend Hodge, whose uncle's hot springs have gone dry — perhaps due to an Absol spotted nearby.
episodes.title: Absol Absolved

episodes.synopsis: Ash receives a letter from an old friend in Unova: Iris! He and Goh head to Opelucid City so Ash can face her in a World Coronation Series battle.
episodes.title: Thrash of the Titans!

episodes.synopsis: Goh and Ash travel to Kalos to find a new flower for one of Goh's Flabébé. After a few days, they visit a plant researcher for some expert insights.
episodes.title: Under Color of Darkness!

episodes.synopsis: Officer Jenny and an Inspector Decker visit the lab, searching for the culprit in a series of electricity thefts. Decker decides Pikachu is responsible!
episodes.title: Sleuths for Truth!

episodes.synopsis: Ash and Goh travel to Pallet to visit Professor Oak, who offers Goh a job on the Project Mew research team. They also run into Ash's old frenemy, Gary.
episodes.title: Advice to Goh!

episodes.synopsis: Goh and Chloe dispatch their Grookey and Eevee on an errand together but secretly follow them to supervise. Team Rocket do the same with Pelipper.
episodes.title: Errand Endurance!

episodes.synopsis: After trying and failing to get rid of their Morpeko, Team Rocket hatch a plan to get Goh to capture it so they don't have to feed it anymore.
episodes.title: Take My Thief! Please!

episodes.synopsis: Goh travels to the Sinnoh region for his first mission with Project Mew, accompanied by Ash. It turns out, becoming a full team member is quite a trial!
episodes.title: Leaping Toward the Dream!

episodes.synopsis: Ash, Goh and Chloe travel to Driftveil City after hearing about a Klink. Surprised in a cave by Team Rocket, the two groups' members get mixed up!
episodes.title: Everybody's Doing the Underground Shuffle!

episodes.synopsis: After learning about Falinks from Professor Cerise, Ash and Goh go to Galar to see one. Meanwhile, an Eiscue adrift on an ice floe washes up in Galar.
episodes.title: Grabbing the Brass Ring!

episodes.synopsis: Goh and Ash head to Sinnoh after reports of nightmares, suspecting the mythical Pokémon Darkrai is responsible. Chloe and Eevee travel to Sinnoh too.
episodes.title: Nightfall? Nightmares!

episodes.synopsis: Dawn and Chloe find an injured Cresselia and are able to give it first aid. Ash and Goh are still on Darkrai's trail, and so is Team Rocket.
episodes.title: A Midsummer Night's Light!

episodes.synopsis: Ash and Goh race through the mountains on a deserted island in the Alola region — where they meet the lively All-Out brothers, Phil and Mayshure.
episodes.title: All Out, All of the Time!

episodes.synopsis: Ash has leveled up to the Ultra Class! Now, he must face gym leader Volkner in a blazing battle in solar-powered Sunyshore City.
episodes.title: Excitement from the Ultra-Shocking Start!

episodes.synopsis: Something has caused the Cerise Lab's data to suddenly vanish. Drizzile helps the team track down the mysterious culprit.
episodes.title: Detective Drizzile!

episodes.synopsis: Adam, Goh and Chloe arrive at Eclipse Castle to meet Espeon and Umbreon and see their special Pokémon powers firsthand.
episodes.title: Night and Day, You Are the Ones!

episodes.synopsis: In search of Volcarona, the Sun Pokémon, Ash and Goh head to the Colossus Ruins in the Unova region for Goh's first trial mission from Project Mew.
episodes.title: Trial on a Golden Scale!

episodes.synopsis: The crew spies the rare and spherical Voltorb and bumps into Gorman, a blue Pokémon fanatic. But Team Rocket plots to ruin the fun with this new friend.
episodes.title: Mad About Blue!

episodes.synopsis: The tasty Alcremie, a Pokémon made of cream, floats toward Goh and pals. Later, gym leader Opal arranges a special challenge with Leon.
episodes.title: The Sweet Taste of Battle!

episodes.synopsis: Ash and Goh run into champion Cynthia while investigating strange phenomena in the Johto region, where daytime has plunged into total darkness.
episodes.title: Star Night, Star Flight!

episodes.synopsis: Ash receives a mega glove from cheerleader Korrina in Shalour City. Later, the gang searches for a mega stone to help Lucario mega evolve.
episodes.title: An Adventure of Mega Proportions!

episodes.synopsis: Ash and Bea have already faced off twice. Will Ash have better luck during their third showdown at Stow-on-Side Stadium with Korrina in the stands?
episodes.title: Battle Three with Bea!

episodes.synopsis: With a contentious back-and-forth battle with Bea, Ash brings out Sirfetch'd, Pikachu and Lucario to bolster his attacks and defensive strength.
episodes.title: A Battle of Mega Versus Max!

episodes.synopsis: Goh brings Ash along to school for a presentation. Later, transfer student Regina and her Glaceon Pokémon cause a freeze over the entire class.
episodes.title: Breaking the Ice!

episodes.synopsis: Ash and Goh dive into the deep waters of the Hoenn region for Goh's trial mission. This time, he's off to catch a wild Kingdra, a Dragon Pokémon.
episodes.title: Looking Out for Number Two!

episodes.synopsis: Team Rocket shows up while Ash, Goh and Chloe travel to the Sinnoh region to investigate multiple missing Pokémon reports — including Dawn's Piplup.
episodes.title: The Gates of Warp! (1)

episodes.synopsis: Time's running out and flowing backwards as Ash, Goh and friends enter a strange world and battle alongside different versions of themselves.
episodes.title: Showdown at the Gates of Warp! (2)

episodes.synopsis: On their way to catch a ride to Stow-on-Side, Ash and Goh take a wild trip aboard a mysterious and eerie ghost train.
episodes.title: The Spectral Express!

episodes.synopsis: Hoping to get his Pokémon Gengar to Gigantamax, Ash and Goh look for help from the Ghost-type gym leader, Allister.
episodes.title: The Winding Path to Greatness!

episodes.synopsis: After unusual magnetic waves affect his Magnemite, Francois, Ren works together with Ash, Goh, Chrysa and Professor Cerise to solve the mystery.
episodes.title: It's All in the Name!

episodes.synopsis: When Lilligant draws the romantic interest of its beloved Heracross, Pinsir is devastated. Could a Pokémon flower arrangement class save the day?
episodes.title: Suffering the Flings and Arrows!

episodes.synopsis: Tired of their missions always coming up short, Team Rocket decides to follow Pelipper to find out who's in charge of the Prize Master.
episodes.title: The Good, the Bad and the Lucky!

episodes.synopsis: The Space Center plans to use Ampharos' light to guide a satellite back home. But after Ampharos loses confidence, it's up to Sophocles to save the day.
episodes.title: Lighting the Way Home!

episodes.synopsis: Hoping to add to his collection, Goh brings Ash along with him to Slowpoke Island. After meeting different Slowpokes, they try the local cuisine.
episodes.title: An Evolution in Taste!

episodes.synopsis: Ash, Goh and Chloe visit a Pokémon Circus, where the closing performers run into a problem after the evolutions of their Eevees don't go as planned.
episodes.title: Out of Their Elements!

episodes.synopsis: As the Pokémon World Coronation Series continues, Ash looks to challenge a rising star from the Galar region — but gets wrong directions from Team Yell.
episodes.title: Battling Turned Up to Eleven!

episodes.synopsis: While Goh goes to look for Pokémon in the Galar region, Ash ends up training with one of the world's greatest trainers, Leon.
episodes.title: Meeting Up with the Monarch!

episodes.synopsis: Traveling out to the Wild Area, Ash and Goh encounter a Thwackey with a problem: It only seems to have one stick when it needs two.
episodes.title: A One-Stick Wonder!

episodes.synopsis: As he takes on his latest Project Mew trial mission, Goh and a few allies challenge the legendary Pokémon Articuno to a raid battle.
episodes.title: Battling in the Freezing Raid!

episodes.synopsis: To master a new attack, Sirfetch'd gets unexpected help from Dracovish. But will the move be enough for Ash to survive his upcoming battles?
episodes.title: The Future Is Now, Thanks to Strategy!

episodes.synopsis: In a battle against Drasna, Ash realizes a strong bond between Pokémon is the most important skill of all.
episodes.title: Taking Two for the Team!

episodes.synopsis: While on a visit to Lilycove City to meet a Sylveon, Chloe gets recognized by Lisia, who encourages her to compete in a Pokémon Contest.
episodes.title: Reuniting for the First Time!

episodes.synopsis: To drum up more support for Team Rocket, Jessie and James take over a radio broadcast and win over some unexpected fans.
episodes.title: Radio Lulled the Mischievous Stars!

episodes.synopsis: When the Pokémon in Cerise Park get out of sorts, it's up to a helpful Yamper to set things right again.
episodes.title: Big Brother to the Rescue!

episodes.synopsis: Hoping to help his Lucario grow stronger, Ash heads to the Kalos region to reconnect with Greninja, who teaches its protégé a thing or two.
episodes.title: Catching the Aura of Fate!

episodes.synopsis: Ash must survive an entrance battle with a popular trainer to earn a spot in the top eight. But in the arena, all eyes are on the underdog from Kanto.
episodes.title: Aim for the Eight!

episodes.synopsis: On his next trial mission for Project Mew, Goh must win a survival contest in Sea Mauville or he won't qualify as one of the chosen three Chasers.
episodes.title: Narrowing the Chaser Chase!

episodes.synopsis: In a frozen land, Ash, Goh and Chloe search for a rare Pokémon while Lillie and her family hope to reunite with their missing father.
episodes.title: The Homecoming Crown!

episodes.synopsis: Back in the Alola region, Ash joins a Battle Royal with three other trainers. But when any team can attack any Pokémon, who will survive?
episodes.title: Helping the Hometown Hero!

episodes.synopsis: Goh competes in his final trial mission for Project Mew: capturing a Regieleki and Regidrago. Will he receive enough tokens to earn the title of Chaser?
episodes.title: Chasing to the Finish!

episodes.synopsis: To prepare for the Masters Eight Tournament, Ash reunites with his many Pokémon partners to battle an old rival and get as strong as possible.
episodes.title: Friends, Rivals, Lend Me Your Spirit!

episodes.synopsis: The Pokémon World Coronation Series Masters Eight Tournament is underway! Ash arrives at Wyndon Stadium just in time for a battle between Leon and Alain.
episodes.title: Curtain Up! Fight the Fights!

episodes.synopsis: At the Masters Eight Tournament, Ash, Goh and their new friend Hop watch as Lance goes head to head with Diantha on the stage of dreams.
episodes.title: Pride of a Champion!

episodes.synopsis: Ash and his friends cheer on Cynthia and Iris in the third battle of the Masters Eight Tournament. With only one match left, will Ash's training pay off?
episodes.title: The Fiery Road to Mastership!

episodes.synopsis: Ash battles Steven Stone in the Masters Eight Tournament. But can the Alola region champion prove he belongs on the same stage as the toughest trainers?
episodes.title: Battling as Hard as Stone!

episodes.synopsis: Barrierd has launched the so-called "Barri Channel" in order to shed light on the seven wonders of the Sakuragi Laboratories! What it's going to shed light on this time is Koharu's non-evolving Eievui?! Can it solve the mystery of this Eievui?! In addition, the radio show "You Are Swift Radio" is soliciting listeners to submit their problems?!
episodes.title: Koharu and Eievui - The Miracle of Evolution

episodes.synopsis: On a camping trip with her family, Chloe encounters friends from her father's past who help guide her in her decision whether or not to evolve Eevee.
episodes.title: Infinite Possibilities!

episodes.synopsis: The Pokémon World Championships semifinals are starting any minute now! But first, PWCS News will bring us an exclusive, thorough analysis of the Masters Tournament! They'll present all kinds of material ranging from analyses of the various competitors to confidential information on them! In addition, the radio show "A Dragon Dive Into Your Hearts" will present letters from its listeners!
episodes.title: The Climax Begins! Satoshi's Masters Tournament Experience!!

episodes.synopsis: On the morning of Leon and Diantha's battle, Ash and Cynthia run into two young fans who are full of questions about selecting Pokémon partners.
episodes.title: It's... Champion Time! (1)

episodes.synopsis: In the semifinals, the Sinnoh region champion Cynthia battles the very first Alola region champion Ash for the chance to take on the undefeated Leon.
episodes.title: Bewitch, Battle, and Bewilder! (2)

episodes.synopsis: As the epic battle continues, underdog Ash struggles to keep up with champion Cynthia's aggressive strategy — but he won't go down without a fight.
episodes.title: Valor: A Strategic Part of Battling! (3)

episodes.synopsis: The battle rages on, but Ash is down to his last Pokémon: Lucario. Can the power of their bond see them through to a victory over the Sinnoh champion?
episodes.title: Whittle While You Work! (4)

episodes.synopsis: A suspicious shadow is sneaking up on Go's Smartphone Rotom in the hotel room he and Satoshi are staying at in Shoot City in the Galar region... We'll be shedding light on the info on Go's Pokémon and the top secret data on Project Mew contained within?! In addition, the radio show "A Blaze Kick After School" will be doing a special on childhood friends!!
episodes.title: GO FOR DREAM! Go's Road to Mew!!

episodes.synopsis: On the eve of the finals, Ash and Goh enjoy a day off in town and run into a group of Nickit who've become popular for teaching other Pokémon to behave.
episodes.title: Just a Scone's Throw from Here!

episodes.synopsis: It's time for the Masters Tournament Finals, which will determine who's the best in the world, and PWCS News is doing a special that will present the finals the world is eagerly awaiting in greater detail than anywhere else! The special will provide a thorough coverage of not only highlights of Satoshi and Dande's battles, but also of the various encounters between the two! In addition, the special has obtained some exclusive news it's going to break?!
episodes.title: Climax! The Night Before the Decisive Battle! Satoshi VS Dande!!

episodes.synopsis: While Goh answers an emergency call from Project Mew, Ash heads into the finals of the Masters Eight Tournament, where Leon requests a full power battle.
episodes.title: A Flood of Torrential Gains! (1)

episodes.synopsis: With each competitor down to their final five Pokémon, the battle wages. Ash fights to get an advantage over Leon, who effortlessly sets the pace.
episodes.title: Toying with Your Motions! (2)

episodes.synopsis: The fierce battle to determine who the strongest trainer is continues. Will Ash manage to see himself through to the ultimate victory?
episodes.title: Paring Pokémon While Parrying! (3)

episodes.synopsis: The mysterious appearance of a legendary Eternatus above Wyndon Stadium grants Ash and Leon a bonus round, where it comes down to partner versus partner.
episodes.title: Partners in Time! (4)

episodes.synopsis: After picking up psychic energy signals, the Chasers set out to scale treacherous Table Mountain in search of Mew... but find surprises along the way.
episodes.title: The Mew from Here!

episodes.synopsis: On Faraway Island, the Chasers make a startling discovery and find themselves transported to a mysterious realm, where Goh connects with an old friend.
episodes.title: In the Palms of Our Hands!

episodes.synopsis: Goh has a new ambition to become a trainer worthy of partnering with Mew — but he's not sure how to broach the topic while camping with Ash and Chloe.
episodes.title: Heroes Unite!
